vectors.observation: No headed/manual play occurred, so the exact human drop-off moment is not proven. Static/code evidence says the hook now starts playable quickly after New Game, but the conflict is a text line plus a non-damaging pulse.
vectors.fix_direction: Run true headed play first, then tighten the first visible conflict around signal, pulse, and Oakhaven pull.

vectors.evidence_type: CORRECTED HEADLESS RUNTIME EVIDENCE + STATIC CODE EVIDENCE
vectors.observation: Movement, SignalFragment interaction, pulse flag, and path completion work headlessly. The actual loop is move, press interact, avoid/enter pulse, exit. The pulse has no damage, failure, knockback, resource cost, or hard consequence.
vectors.fix_direction: Add one readable consequence/feedback beat without broad combat changes, and make each micro-action visibly change the route.

vectors.observation: A2 removes the long passive prologue from New Game, but after the 0.45s OakhavenPath completion it hands control back to the existing overworld/Oakhaven route. That post-hook pacing is still unvalidated.
vectors.fix_direction: After manual A2 validation, redesign objective handoff from crater to Oakhaven as a single clear first quest chain.
vectors.recommended_phase: 10N-A3 objective clarity and first quest redesign

vectors.observation: The script warns that the memory scar is dangerous, but the pulse handler only sets a flag, shows text, and shakes camera.
vectors.fix_direction: Add harmless but real gameplay consequence: short knockback, route distortion, screen static, or temporary control disruption.

vectors.observation: The first objective is clear, but objective state is split between local HUD text and ProgressionBreadcrumb flag logic. Completion sets four compatibility flags at once.
vectors.fix_direction: Define one first-quest state machine and one visible objective source for the opening handoff.
vectors.recommended_phase: 10N-A3 objective clarity and first quest redesign

vectors.observation: The opening teaches movement via text: Move with WASD. Inspect the broken signal fragment. The prompt is functional but not embedded in the environment.
vectors.fix_direction: Use spatial staging: player wakes facing the fragment, route ping activates after movement, prompt appears only near the object.

vectors.observation: The hook builds visual ColorRects but no StaticBody2D boundaries or debris collision. A confused player can likely wander through or beyond the intended space while the camera limits clamp.
vectors.fix_direction: Add non-art blocking and route shaping with existing collision primitives, then validate with headed play.

vectors.observation: No headed save/retry test happened. The hook completion sets flags and transitions, but no checkpoint/autosave call is visible in the opening hook.
vectors.fix_direction: After headed validation, decide whether first Oakhaven arrival should autosave or checkpoint.
vectors.recommended_phase: 10N-A3 objective clarity and first quest redesign

vectors.observation: The hook uses transient message labels, not DialogueManager. DialogueManager has typewriter/skip/choices, but the first minute does not teach dialogue controls.
vectors.fix_direction: Add persistent inspect log or repeatable signal text before the first true dialogue scene.
vectors.recommended_phase: 10N-A3 objective clarity and first quest redesign

vectors.observation: The Oakhaven death loop / Elara marker line is the strongest curiosity gap, but it is one temporary text message with no character present.
vectors.fix_direction: Turn the signal into a repeatable micro-discovery that points to a visible next mystery.
vectors.recommended_phase: 10N-A3 objective clarity and first quest redesign

vectors.observation: The opening hook has no meaningful choice. Later Oakhaven has warn/quietly style choices, but they are not seeded in the first playable minute.
vectors.fix_direction: Add a small Chapter 1 dilemma after the first objective, not inside the unvalidated hook.
vectors.recommended_phase: 10N-A3 objective clarity and first quest redesign

vectors.observation: The hook has no visible NPC or companion. Elara is a name in a signal line, and the protagonist has only one internal message.
vectors.fix_direction: Use the first quest to make Elara or another anchor visible through action, not exposition.
vectors.recommended_phase: 10N-A3 objective clarity and first quest redesign

vectors.observation: Many ending and route flags exist later in GameManager, but no early action visibly teaches that choices will matter.
vectors.fix_direction: Seed one small tracked Chapter 1 choice with clear later-readable consequences.

vectors.observation: GameManager has a large string-flag dictionary and some mutual-exclusion handling, but consequence state appears spread across scripts.
vectors.fix_direction: Introduce documented choice groups and validation assertions before expanding branches.

vectors.observation: The first three minutes did not reach combat in headed play. The hook pulse is not combat and does not teach attack/defense.
vectors.fix_direction: Do not add combat to A2; redesign the first true encounter as its own phase.

vectors.observation: The opening hook has no XP, item, skill, permanent unlock, or visible reward beyond route progression.
vectors.fix_direction: Add a first reward beat after the Oakhaven signal or first quest, preferably information plus a small usable mechanic.
vectors.recommended_phase: 10N-A3 objective clarity and first quest redesign

vectors.observation: Inventory autoload grants starter items at startup. The hook does not introduce resources, gold, scarcity, or why items matter.
vectors.fix_direction: Delay economy teaching until the first Oakhaven problem gives consumables/materials a reason to exist.
vectors.recommended_phase: 10N-A3 objective clarity and first quest redesign

vectors.observation: Crafting uses hardcoded recipes and materials in CraftingSystem, and it is not introduced in the opening.
vectors.fix_direction: Do not teach crafting in minute one; attach it to a later Chapter 1 obstacle.

vectors.observation: ShopSystem is global and feature-rich, with buy/sell/filter/sort, but shop data is mostly in code dictionaries.
vectors.fix_direction: Later move shop catalogs/prices to data resources after early quest flow is fixed.

vectors.observation: No headed play reached XP or level-up. The opening hook does not award XP or show a build promise.
vectors.fix_direction: Make the first combat/reward phase teach one future build hook.

vectors.observation: Materials exist in CraftingSystem, but early distribution and grind pressure were not live tested.
vectors.fix_direction: Audit material drops only after the first quest and first encounter are stable.

vectors.observation: Inventory has stack caps but no weight system, avoiding early burden. Max stack checks exist.
vectors.fix_direction: Leave weight/caps alone until core first-hour retention works.

vectors.observation: Root Access/Data Vision exist in input and player code, but the opening hook does not give a controlled taste of build direction.
vectors.fix_direction: Use the first quest or first encounter to preview one signature ability, not the whole system.
vectors.recommended_phase: 10N-A3 objective clarity and first quest redesign

vectors.observation: Faction/choice impact on shops is not visible in early systems. Shop prices are mostly fixed code data.
vectors.fix_direction: Defer until Chapter 1 choices are stable, then wire one visible price/consequence example.

vectors.observation: Shop UI is programmatic and centralized, which is useful, but item catalogs and pricing remain hardcoded.
vectors.fix_direction: Later split shop content data from UI code.

vectors.observation: Recipes include early consumables and late material outputs, but the dependency loop is not tied to the first quest yet.
vectors.fix_direction: Design Chapter 1 recipes around a concrete player problem before expanding.

vectors.observation: Player stamina and combat cooldown-style systems exist, but the opening does not teach resource pressure.
vectors.fix_direction: Teach only one resource constraint at a time, starting after the hook.

vectors.observation: The opening hook is reversible and scoped, but it runtime-builds a full scene and duplicates HUD/prompt concepts already present globally.
vectors.fix_direction: Keep A2 hook, then consolidate first-minute objective/prompt ownership in A3/A5.

vectors.observation: DialogueManager supports choices, but Oakhaven dialogue content is hardcoded arrays inside scene scripts.
vectors.fix_direction: Move Chapter 1 dialogue data to resources/JSON only after the playable flow is fixed.

vectors.observation: A2 completion sets several legacy compatibility flags directly. Breadcrumbs, GameManager, and scene scripts read overlapping flags.
vectors.fix_direction: Document a Chapter 1 state contract and add validation probes for stale/objective flags.

vectors.observation: Ending and NG+ flags exist as many string booleans. There is not yet a typed route ledger for long-play consequences.
vectors.fix_direction: Do not solve now; introduce typed route summaries before adding new endings.

vectors.observation: Opening hook creates Area2D interactables/hazards but no solid map collision. Player collision exists, but there are no authored solids in the hook scene.
vectors.fix_direction: Add minimal opening-only StaticBody2D boundaries and validate confused-player wandering.

vectors.observation: GameManager centralizes state, travel, flags, stats, saves, NG+, and free travel. This is practical but high coupling.
vectors.fix_direction: Do not refactor broadly now; add small contracts/tests around Chapter 1 state.

vectors.observation: NG+ still routes to the legacy prologue and has dedicated state setup. A2 did not redirect NG+ into the new hook.
vectors.fix_direction: Leave NG+ untouched until the base opening is proven headed.

vectors.evidence_type: HEADED LAUNCH LOG + STATIC CODE EVIDENCE
vectors.observation: Corrected visible startup reached Vulkan on RTX 2050 and initialized autoloads. Exit logs reported leaked Texture/RID warnings. Many global systems initialize before play.
vectors.fix_direction: After gameplay flow stabilizes, audit autoload startup cost and exit cleanup.

vectors.evidence_type: CORRECTED HEADLESS RUNTIME EVIDENCE + NOT VALIDATED
vectors.observation: Headless movement moved the player 28.586 px under simulated move_right. Actual feel, acceleration, camera smoothing, and keyboard latency were not headed-tested.
vectors.fix_direction: Manual headed play must judge movement, stop distance, camera smoothing, and prompt range.

vectors.observation: Options supports key rebinding, but the opening prompt says F interact/E inspect while player code treats both interact/root_access as the same interaction call near an object.
vectors.fix_direction: Align first-minute prompt labels with actual action behavior and expose controls cleanly.

vectors.observation: Project viewport is 1280x720 with viewport stretch. 21:9, 4K, pixel scaling, and text fitting were not headed-tested.
vectors.fix_direction: After headed 16:9 pass, test 1366x768, 1920x1080, ultrawide, and scaling.

vectors.observation: Movement uses physics delta and tweens/timers are common. Combat effects manipulate Engine.time_scale.
vectors.fix_direction: Later test 60/144/240 Hz with movement/combat probes.

vectors.observation: Large data sets for quests, shops, crafting, flags, and free travel are embedded in scripts.
vectors.fix_direction: Do not refactor now; migrate only after early-game flow stabilizes.

vectors.observation: No platform integration was inspected beyond save file structure and achievements logs.
vectors.fix_direction: Defer until core first hour is worth retaining.

vectors.observation: ObjectPool exists and CombatEffects reserves damage label pooling, but startup/exit logs include texture/RID leak warnings.
vectors.fix_direction: Audit pooling/cleanup after gameplay priority fixes.

vectors.observation: No headed play reached NPC/enemy pathfinding. Enemy scripts exist but were not validated in this phase.
vectors.fix_direction: Validate with the first encounter redesign, not now.

vectors.observation: Opening completion waits 0.45s and calls SceneTransitions/change_scene. No async loading or transition interception was headed-tested.
vectors.fix_direction: Validate transition feel in headed play, then add a clear route/arrival beat if needed.

vectors.observation: A2.3/A2.4 needed explicit --log-file to avoid startup command issues. There is no player-facing crash report path in the inspected code.
vectors.fix_direction: Add a documented local log collection flow later; do not change runtime now.

vectors.evidence_type: STATIC SCENE EVIDENCE + STATIC CODE EVIDENCE
vectors.observation: The main menu includes New Game, Skip Prologue, Load, Options, Chapter Select, Credits, Completion, Quit, and a debug legacy button in debug builds. Fresh-player menu may look like a developer build.
vectors.fix_direction: For player builds, hide debug/chapter completion shortcuts behind an explicit debug menu.

vectors.observation: The opening can show a local top-left objective panel and global top-right breadcrumb for the same task. Player prompt plus world label can duplicate interaction text. Several strings in menu/breadcrumb show mojibake sequences.
vectors.fix_direction: Choose one objective surface for the hook, fix key labels, and repair text encoding artifacts.

vectors.observation: Save uses user:// save slots with tmp/backup handling and save version merge. Steam Cloud/Alt-F4 corruption behavior was not tested.
vectors.fix_direction: Keep current save schema untouched; later test cloud-friendly path and crash-safe writes.

vectors.observation: Options include fullscreen, VSync, resolution, accessibility toggles, text size, colorblind mode, difficulty, and key rebinding.
vectors.fix_direction: Do not expand settings until manual UI testing identifies actual friction.

vectors.observation: No headed audio playback was observed. Main menu calls MusicManager, but opening hook does not call music/SFX for signal, pulse, or transition.
vectors.fix_direction: After visual/manual validation, add minimal existing SFX cues if available; do not generate audio.
